description: Archive snapshot retrieved 2026-10-03 (scripts/sky-fetch.ts on GitHub's runners, processed by scripts/sky-process.ts). Gaia DR3 five- or six-parameter solutions with RUWE < 1.4 and parallax/error > 100 for 141 of 252 stars; otherwise SIMBAD's adopted values, each cited by bibcode. Positions propagated to J2016.0. Positions (J2000), proper motions, distances and spectral types from the HYG star database v4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Extracted by scripts/extract-catalogs.ts; provisional until the archive snapshot verifies it.
